description: This Java class, CollectEffectedSubjectIdsVisitor, is a visitor implementation used in the context of policy evaluation for collecting subject IDs affected by permission changes within a resource tree. It traverses policy tree nodes, evaluates permissions at different resource levels, and gathers subject IDs that are either granted or revoked permissions based on specified expected permissions.

classes.name: CollectEffectedSubjectIdsVisitor
classes.description: A deprecated class that implements a visitor for traversing a resource policy tree to determine affected subject IDs based on permission evaluation.

classes.name: ResourceNodeEvaluator
classes.description: An inner class responsible for evaluating permissions for a specific subject ID within the resource tree during traversal.

methods.name: CollectEffectedSubjectIdsVisitor

methods.name: get
methods.description: Compiles and returns the collection of subject IDs that are effected, based on accumulated evaluations.
